newsitem.title: south korea: S.Korean yields close flat, caution prevails.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean yields close flat, caution prevails.

text.p: Yields on three-year corporates closed flat on Friday as institutions became cautious after a rally earlier this week, brokers said.
But three-month CDs fell on the strength of ample liquidity in the shorter-term money market. Overnight call rate closed unchanged, they said.
* 3-mth CDs close at 12.23 pct vs 12.30 pct on Thursday
Brokers said new issues approved for June were valued at 2.81 trillion won, compared with 2.46 trillion in May.
Three-month CDs fell slightly on the strength of ample liquidity in the shorter-term money market. Overnight call rates closed unchanged, they said.
